comments.text:
🔥 WHAT MUST YOU DO?
The Bible gives us a simple answer.
Romans 10:9 says:
“If you confess with your mouth the Lord Jesus and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved.”
Salvation is not about simply attending church.
It is not merely about carrying a Bible.
It is not about saying that you are a Christian while your heart remains far from Christ.
Salvation is surrendering your life to Jesus Christ.
Repent of your sins.
Believe in Jesus.
Receive Him as Lord and Savior.
Turn away from your old life and begin walking with Him.
🙏 PRAYER OF SALVATION
If you sincerely want to give your life to Jesus, pray this prayer from your heart:
“Lord Jesus, I come before You today. I acknowledge that I am a sinner and that I cannot save myself. I believe that You died for my sins and that You rose again from the dead. I repent of my sins. Please forgive me and cleanse me. I believe in You and I receive You as my Lord and Savior. Take control of my life. Help me to follow You and live according to Your Word. From today, I belong to You. Thank You for saving me. In Jesus' name, Amen.”
🕊️ IF YOU PRAYED THAT PRAYER
If you sincerely trusted Jesus, begin your new life with Him.
📖 2 Corinthians 5:17:
 “If any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.”
Start reading the Bible.
Pray every day.
Find a Bible-believing church.
Stay away from sinful influences that pull you away from Christ.
And tell someone about what Jesus has done for you.
🔥 FINAL APPEAL
My friend, Jesus is calling you.
Don't wait until your life is perfect.
Don't wait until tomorrow.
Don't assume you will always have another opportunity.
Today is the day of salvation.
The world can give you temporary pleasure, but Jesus gives you eternal life.
The world can give you possessions, but Jesus gives you peace.
The world can know your past, but Jesus can give you a new beginning.
Come to Jesus.
He loves you.
He died for you.
He rose again for you.
And He is calling you today.
Give your life to Jesus Christ.
📖 2 Corinthians 6:2:
 “Behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.”
Jesus is waiting. Come to Him today.
